name: Tonk
description: Tonk (or Tunk) is a fast-paced matching card game popular in the USA. It combines features of Rummy and 'Knock' games (like Gin). Players aim to form spreads (books/runs) or 'Drop' (knock) with a low point count.

overview.description: Tonk (or Tunk) is a fast-paced matching card game popular in the USA. It combines features of Rummy and 'Knock' games (like Gin). Players aim to form spreads (books/runs) or 'Drop' (knock) with a low point count.

history.origins: Popularized in the mid-20th century, particularly in African American communities and jazz culture.
timeline: Mid-20th century: Popularized in African American communities and jazz culture; played by blues and jazz musicians in southern Louisiana.

rules.objective: By drawing and discarding, form your cards into spreads (books of equal rank or runs in suit) or add to existing spreads. You win by getting rid of all your cards (tonk out or run out) or by having the lowest point count when someone drops (knocks).
rules.gameplay: 1. Check for Instant Win (49/50 points). 2. Draw (Stock/Discard). 3. Meld/Hit (Optional). 4. Discard. 5. Drop (Knock): Can be done before drawing if confident in low points. Opponents challenge.

strategy.basic: Drop if under 15 points early. Hit others to reduce hand size.
strategy.intermediate: Don't hold spreads in hand too long; play them to reduce count.
strategy.advanced: Bluffing by not dropping. Calculating 'Hit' potential.

variations.name: Deal size

scoring.description: Winner takes pot/stake. Penalties for being caught (having higher points than someone else after dropping).
scoring.winCondition: Go out (Tonk) or Drop with lowest points.
